requestBody.query: instructions for returning mobile device and accesories in store

200.answer: To return your mobile device and accessories in-store, go to your nearest Bell store. A representative will inspect the phone, and you'll know the outcome immediately. All manuals and accessories must be included.

How to return your phone Return in store Returning your phone in-store will provide you the best customer experience for the following reasons: You will be able to explore all options available to you with a store representative, including returning your phone, doing a trade-in (with bonus credit, if applicable), or keeping the phone and adding another line. The phone will be inspected in-store within minutes and you will know the outcome of the inspection on the return immediately. The value of the phone is guaranteed. To return in store, simply go to your nearest Bell store (use the filter to find locations that offer mobile repairs) and speak with a representative.

requestBody.query: packing, label and shipping instructions for returning mobile device and accesories online

200.answer:
To return a mobile device and accessories purchased online:
*   Package the device in its original packaging, or a suitable box with protection, including all manuals and accessories.
*   Attach the provided return shipping label.
*   Drop off the package at any Canada Post outlet or Purolator drop-off location.

Or have the clerk print the return label and process your return at any Canada Post outlet . 3 Ship Take the package to any Canada Post outlet Take the package to any Purolator drop-off location . Once we receive the device, we'll process the return and then send you a confirmation email (processing times may vary). There is no need to call us. Step 1: Package Return your device in its original packaging. If you no longer have the original packaging, use another suitable box with proper protection. Include all the manuals and accessories.
